topic: Why freelancers and agencies get no clients
caption:
Freelancer ho ya agency, skills hain par client nahi.

Ek small agency ne website banayi, portfolio banaya, aur intezaar kiya. Mahine nikal gaye, inquiry ek bhi nahi.

Yeh teen wajah hoti hain:
1. Aap intezaar karte ho, aur outreach nahi karte.
2. Client skills nahi, result khareedta hai.
3. Aap sirf ek jagah par ho, baaki jagah invisible.

Plan chahiye? Comment "CLIENTS" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#freelancer #smallagency #findclients #freelancingtips #thetotalforge
firstComment: Plan chahiye? Comment "CLIENTS" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Freelancer ho ya agency, skills hain par client nahi. Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Client dhoondne ka plan:
1. Roz 5 logon ko pehle message karo. Intezaar nahi.
2. Skill nahi, unka problem aur result likho: [problem] ko [result] mein badlo.
3. Ek nahi, teen jagah par raho: LinkedIn, ek marketplace, aur ek chhota community thread.

Pehle hafte sirf step 1 karo, aur likho kitne reply aaye.

topic: 3 lesser-known places to find US clients
caption:
Upwork pe sab hain, bhai. Yeh teen spots pe kam log jaate hain.

Ek new agency owner roz Upwork pe proposals bhejta raha. Competition full on, reply zero. Bhai, cooked.

Yeh teen spots try karo:
1. Hacker News ka freelancer thread. Companies wahan seedha freelancer dhoondti hain.
2. Clutch. Free profile banao, buyers wahan agencies dhoondte hain.
3. Sortlist. Free listing, aur buyers wahan agency dhoondte hain.

List chahiye? Comment "HIDDEN" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Fees aur rules badalte rehte hain, platform par ek baar check kar lein.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#freelancing #findclients #usclients #smallagency #thetotalforge
firstComment: List chahiye? Comment "HIDDEN" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Upwork pe sab hain, bhai. Yeh teen spots pe kam log jaate hain. Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Kam jaani jaane wali jagah, US clients ke liye:
1. Hacker News: har mahine Ask HN: Freelancer? Seeking freelancer? thread aata hai. SEEKING FREELANCER posts padho, aur SEEKING WORK se apna post karo (location aur remote ka zikr likho).
2. Clutch: agency profile banao (free basic profile). Buyers wahan service ke hisaab se agencies dhoondte hain.
3. Sortlist: free registration aur listing. Buyers wahan agencies dhoondne aate hain.

Har jagah ke rules alag hain, post karne se pehle unhe padh lein. Clutch aur Sortlist agencies ke liye hain, toh solo freelancer apni chhoti team ke naam se list kar sakta hai.

caption:
Chalis proposals, reply zero. Bhai, scene kya hai?

Ek freelancer ne sabko wahi copy paste proposal bheja. Pehli line thi, hello sir, I am an expert. Client ne do second mein tab close kar diya.

Yeh teen moves lo:
1. Pehli line mein client ki problem bolo, apna intro nahi.
2. Ek relevant project ka proof do, bas do line mein.
3. End mein ek sawaal pucho, taaki reply banta ho.

Template chahiye? Comment "PROPOSAL" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#freelancingtips #upworktips #proposalwriting #freelancer #thetotalforge
firstComment: Template chahiye? Comment "PROPOSAL" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Chalis proposals, reply zero. Bhai, scene kya hai? Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Proposal template:
1. Pehli line: client ki problem, unhi ke lafzon mein. [client ki problem]
2. Do line: ek relevant project aur uska result. [project, result]
3. Aakhri line: ek sawaal. Jaise: Kya main ek chhota plan bhej doon?

Har proposal ko job ke hisaab se badlo. Copy paste nahi.

topic: Getting paid from US clients in Pakistan
caption:
Client ne payment bhej di. Ab paisa tumhare paas kaise aayega, bhai?

Ek freelancer ne kaam khatam kiya, par payment ka rasta pehle check hi nahi kiya. Last moment pe scene bigad gaya.

Yeh teen cheezein pehle sort karo:
1. Payoneer account banao. Woh tumhe US bank details deta hai.
2. Local bank payout aam taur par ek se teen working days leta hai.
3. Wise Pakistan mein abhi open nahi hai, uspe plan mat banao.

Guide chahiye? Comment "PAYMENT" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Fees aur rules badalte rehte hain, platform par ek baar check kar lein.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#freelancerpakistan #payoneer #getpaid #remotework #thetotalforge

alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Client ne payment bhej di. Ab paisa tumhare paas kaise aayega, bhai? Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
US clients se payment lene ka checklist:
1. Payoneer account banao. Isse aapko US bank details milte hain.
2. Local bank mein payout aam taur par 1 se 3 working days leta hai.
3. Wise abhi Pakistan ke residents ke liye open nahi hai, isliye uspar plan mat banao.
4. Kaam shuru karne se pehle client se poochho: payment kis tarah karenge?

Fees aur rules badalte rehte hain. Payoneer ki official site par current charges check kar lein.

caption:
Sasta kaam karke koi aage nahi gaya, bhai. Sach mein.

Ek freelancer ne sabse kam rate rakha. Clients bohat aaye, par month end pe haath khaali.

Yeh teen cheezein badlo:
1. Ghante ka nahi, project ka price batao.
2. Teen packages rakho. Basic, standard aur premium.
3. Price batane se pehle client ka budget pucho.

Checklist chahiye? Comment "PRICE" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#freelancepricing #freelancingtips #freelancelife #pricingstrategy #thetotalforge
firstComment: Checklist chahiye? Comment "PRICE" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Sasta kaam karke koi aage nahi gaya, bhai. Sach mein. Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Pricing checklist:
1. Ghante ke bajaye project ka price batao.
2. Teen packages: Basic, Standard, Premium. Har ek mein kya milega, likho.
3. Price se pehle poochho: aapka budget kitna hai aur deadline kya hai?
4. Beech wale package ko recommended rakho.

caption:
Client bola kal tak bata do. Tumne parson bataya. Cooked.

Ek freelancer ne client ka message dekha, par raat ko reply kiya. Tab tak client kisi aur freelancer ke saath set ho chuka tha.

Yeh teen cheezein yaad rakho:
1. Mil gaya, kal tak bhejta hoon. Bas itna reply jaldi bhejo.
2. Apne kaam ke fixed ghante batao, taaki time zone ka scene na bane.
3. Har baat likh ke confirm karo, deadline bhi.

Script chahiye? Comment "REPLY" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#clientcommunication #freelancingtips #freelancer #remotework #thetotalforge
firstComment: Script chahiye? Comment "REPLY" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Client bola kal tak bata do. Tumne parson bataya. Cooked. Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Reply script:
1. Pehla reply (kuch ghante ke andar): Message mil gaya. Main aaj [time] tak details bhejta hoon.
2. Apne ghante likho: Main Mon se Fri, [time] se [time] tak online hota hoon.
3. Call ya chat ke baad: Jo humne baat ki: [1], [2], [3]. Deadline [date]. Theek hai?

topic: A LinkedIn profile US clients open
caption:
Bhai, tumhari LinkedIn profile client ko kya bolti hai?

Ek client ne profile kholi. Headline thi, hardworking professional. Usne ek second mein back kar diya.

Yeh teen cheezein theek karo:
1. Headline mein likho, tum kya karte ho aur kiske liye.
2. Featured section mein apne teen best projects lagao.
3. Roz paanch sahi logon ko connect karo, chhote note ke saath.

Checklist chahiye? Comment "LINKEDIN" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#linkedintips #linkedinprofile #freelancer #usclients #thetotalforge
firstComment: Checklist chahiye? Comment "LINKEDIN" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Bhai, tumhari LinkedIn profile client ko kya bolti hai? Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
LinkedIn checklist:
1. Headline: [kya karte ho] for [kiske liye]. Jaise: Shopify developer for skincare brands.
2. Featured: apne 3 best projects.
3. Roz 5 sahi log connect karo, note ke saath: Hi [naam], aapki [cheez] pasand aayi. Main [kaam] karta hoon, shayad kaam aaye.
4. About ki pehli line client ki problem par likho.

caption:
Bees projects ka portfolio, aur zero client. Scene kya hai, yaar?

Ek freelancer ne har chhota bada kaam portfolio mein daal diya. Client scroll karta raha, aur kuch samajh hi nahi aaya.

Yeh teen cheezein karo:
1. Sirf apne teen best projects rakho.
2. Har project mein likho, problem kya thi aur tumne kya kiya.
3. Ek link rakho, aur mobile par kholke check karo.

Template chahiye? Comment "PORTFOLIO" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#portfolio #freelancerportfolio #freelancingtips #webdeveloper #thetotalforge
firstComment: Template chahiye? Comment "PORTFOLIO" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Bees projects ka portfolio, aur zero client. Scene kya hai, yaar? Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Portfolio template (har project ke liye):
1. Project ka naam aur client ka type.
2. Problem: kya masla tha?
3. Kya kiya: 2 line.
4. Result: jo number ya feedback sach mein mila.
5. Ek link ya screenshot.

Sirf 3 best projects rakho, aur link mobile par kholkar check karo.

topic: A cold email to a US business
caption:
Chaar line ki email, aur US client ka reply. Sach mein.

Ek freelancer ne dus businesses ko lambi email bheji, apne baare mein. Reply ek bhi nahi aaya. Cooked.

Yeh teen lines likho:
1. Pehli line mein unki website ki ek specific cheez batao.
2. Doosri line mein ek problem aur uska chhota hal batao.
3. Aakhri line mein sawaal, kya main chhota plan bhej doon?

Template chahiye? Comment "EMAIL" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#coldemail #coldoutreach #freelancingtips #usclients #thetotalforge
firstComment: Template chahiye? Comment "EMAIL" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Chaar line ki email, aur US client ka reply. Sach mein. Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Cold email template (4 line):
Subject: Quick idea for [business name]
1. Maine aapki website par [specific cheez] dekhi.
2. [Problem] ho sakti hai, aur uska ek chhota hal hai: [hal].
3. Maine [relevant kaam] kiya hai: [link].
4. Kya main ek chhota plan bhej doon?

Ek email, ek hi ask. Aur wahi likho jo sach ho.

topic: Before you quit your job for an agency
caption:
Job chhodke agency banani hai? Pehle yeh teen kaam karo, bhai.

Ek banda ek din achanak resign maar ke nikal gaya. Teen mahine baad, na client tha, na plan.

Yeh teen kaam pehle karo:
1. Job ke saath ek chhota paying client pakdo.
2. Ek skill aur ek niche chuno, aur uske teen samples banao.
3. Resign tab karo, jab kharcha nikalne layak clients ho.

Checklist chahiye? Comment "QUIT" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Yeh general tips hain, financial advice nahi. Resign karne se pehle apni situation dekh lein.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#startanagency #quitjob #sidehustle #smallagency #thetotalforge
firstComment: Checklist chahiye? Comment "QUIT" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Job chhodke agency banani hai? Pehle yeh teen kaam karo, bhai. Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Job chhodne se pehle checklist:
1. Job ke saath ek chhota paying client lo (ek chhota project bhi chalega).
2. Ek skill aur ek niche chuno, aur us niche ke teen samples banao.
3. Apna mahine ka kharcha likho, aur dekho clients ki income us kharche ko kitna cover karti hai.
4. Resign tab karo jab client income us kharche ke qareeb ho.

Yeh general checklist hai, financial advice nahi. Apni situation ke hisaab se faisla lein.

caption:
Bas ek chhota sa change. Phir chhe baar. Dimaag ka dahi.

Ek freelancer ne logo banaya. Client ne chhe baar changes maange, aur paisa wahi raha.

Yeh teen cheezein pehle likho:
1. Kaam mein kya kya milega, yeh likh ke batao.
2. Revisions ki limit rakho, jaise do rounds.
3. Shuru karne se pehle aadha advance lo.

Checklist chahiye? Comment "SCOPE" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#scopecreep #freelancingtips #clientwork #freelancelife #thetotalforge
firstComment: Checklist chahiye? Comment "SCOPE" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Bas ek chhota sa change. Phir chhe baar. Dimaag ka dahi. Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Scope checklist:
1. Kya kya milega: deliverables ki list.
2. Kya nahi milega: extra cheezein.
3. Revisions: 2 rounds. Uske baad extra charge.
4. Deadline, aur client se kya chahiye (content, access).
5. Shuru karne se pehle 50% advance.

Yeh sab ek message ya contract mein likhit mein bhejo.

caption:
Client mein yeh red flags dikhein, toh seedha ruk jao.

Ek freelancer ne free test project kiya. Client ne kaam le liya, aur payment kabhi nahi bheji. Ghosted.

Yeh teen flags yaad rakho:
1. Free test project, ya pehle poora kaam dikhao.
2. Advance se inkaar, ya payment baad mein dene ki baat.
3. Budget clear nahi, aur har cheez urgent.

Checklist chahiye? Comment "FLAGS" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#redflags #clientmanagement #freelancingtips #freelancer #thetotalforge

Client red flags:
1. Free test project, ya pehle poora kaam dikhao.
2. Advance se inkaar, ya payment baad mein dene ki baat.
3. Budget saaf nahi, aur har cheez urgent.

Ek flag dikhe toh ruk kar sawaal poochho. Do dikhein toh dobara soch lo.

caption:
Hum sab kuch karte hain. Bhai, isi wajah se kaam nahi milta.

Ek agency ne bola, hum sab kuch karte hain. Client ko samajh hi nahi aaya, isse kaunsa kaam dena hai.

Yeh teen steps lo:
1. Ek tarah ka client chuno, jaise skincare brands.
2. Ek problem chuno, jaise slow Shopify store.
3. Us ek problem ka ek sample banao.

Guide chahiye? Comment "FOCUS" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#niche #agencyniche #smallagency #freelancingtips #thetotalforge
firstComment: Guide chahiye? Comment "FOCUS" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Hum sab kuch karte hain. Bhai, isi wajah se kaam nahi milta. Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Niche chunne ka guide:
1. Ek tarah ka client: jaise skincare brands, dentists ya coaches.
2. Ek problem: jaise slow website ya purani branding.
3. Ek sample: us problem ka ek chhota kaam banao.
4. Headline: [kaam] for [client type].

Shuru mein ek niche, 30 din ke liye. Phir dekho kaunsa reply aata hai.

caption:
Roz sirf tees minute. Agency ka simple routine, bhai.

Ek agency ek din full josh mein kaam karti, aur phir hafte bhar kuch nahi.

Roz yeh teen kaam karo:
1. Paanch clients ko message ya proposal bhejo.
2. Apni profile ya portfolio mein ek chhota sudhaar karo.
3. Ek sheet mein likho, kisne reply kiya aur kisne nahi.

Planner chahiye? Comment "ROUTINE" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

#freelanceroutine #dailyroutine #smallagency #sidehustle #thetotalforge
firstComment: Planner chahiye? Comment "ROUTINE" aur hum DM mein bhej denge.
alt: Animated Hinglish tips reel for freelancers and small agencies: Roz sirf tees minute. Agency ka simple routine, bhai. Three tips, shown on screen.
dm:
Roz 30 minute ka planner:
- 15 min: 5 messages ya proposals.
- 10 min: profile ya portfolio mein ek chhota sudhaar.
- 5 min: sheet mein likho, kisne reply kiya.

Hafte ke end mein dekho: kitne bheje, kitne reply, kya sikha. Agle hafte ek cheez badlo.
